profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Full Stack Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Microservices, AWS | AI-Assisted Development | Building Scalable Systems
profile.summary: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience developing and modernizing enterprise applications, distributed systems, and cloud-based platforms. Experienced in Java, TypeScript, React, Node.js, microservices, and AWS, with a strong background in system design, production reliability, security, and technical leadership. Proven ability to mentor engineers, collaborate across teams, and apply AI-assisted development practices to improve software delivery.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the Profile Redesign initiative, improving network performance through API caching and lazy component rendering while improving maintainability by decoupling SPAs and introducing reusable domain components. 
• Owned the migration of the Node.js / Express BFFs from JavaScript to TypeScript, strengthening type safety and expanding OpenAPI specifications to improve API documentation. 
• Led production reliability efforts across 100+ engineering-owned modules as a subject-matter expert, proactively identifying issues before customer impact and coordinating incident ownership, prioritization, root-cause analysis, and SLA remediation with clear deadlines. 
• Applied GitHub Copilot and specification-driven development practices to accelerate feature implementation and improve code quality. 
• Expanded across new domains and teams by developing hiring automation and Interview Scheduling capabilities, including room reservations and third-party calendar integrations.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped modernize the profile experience from a monolithic architecture to a modular, distributed platform using React SPAs, Node.js / Express BFFs, and Spring Boot microservices. 
• Prototyped and delivered the first MongoDB-backed microservice, moving user and administrative configuration management outside the monolith. 
• Identified and remediated an access-control vulnerability in microservice APIs that allowed users to view unauthorized profiles ahead of a major product release; subsequently served as subject-matter expert for the access-control module. 
• Served periodically as Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies, coordinating sprint planning and execution, removing impediments, and fostering collaboration across engineering and product teams. 
• Mentored engineers and contributed to engineering standards, code review, technical design, and long-term technology direction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced and maintained customer candidate-facing career portals, including monthly regression testing across the customer base. 
• Developed and maintained a critical job distribution service delivering postings to third-party platforms, including Indeed, Facebook, and Appcast; later extended it to support a standardized feed for 100+ additional vendors.

positions.title: Lead Senior Software Developer - Consultant - System Engineering (MTS IV)
positions.description:
• Led and mentored onshore and offshore developers through SDLC iterations, providing technical guidance, refining user stories with business analysts, and coordinating delivery. 
• Developed cloud-based microservices supporting Verizon service plans, features, and recommendations. 
• Contributed to legacy system modernization, including migrations from monolithic applications to cloud-based platforms. 
• Delivered enhancements for key initiatives, including the initial 5G customer launch, Smart Home services, and new Verizon plan offerings.

positions.title: Software Developer - Consultant - System Engineering (MTS III)
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented internal web service APIs (XML/HTTP).  These APIs were mostly responsible for communicating with our BE processes through Oracle OMQ, our DB through JDBC, or other web service clients.
• Worked with team of developers in migrating legacy point of sale application to one that would depend on Oracle ATG products, such as Commerce, Endeca, BCC.
• Integrated ordering path with critical preorder submission API, which was used for order placement on heavy traffic days, such as iPhone launches and Black Friday.
• Supported production releases daytime/nighttime.

positions.title: Software Developer - Member-Applications Staff (MTS II)
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a centralized business rules layer shared across applications and channels, improving code reuse and consistency. 
• Decoupled business logic from frontend UI components and defined service interfaces to integrate frontend applications with web services.

positions.title: Junior Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Maintained LAN/WAN infrastructure, resolved hardware, software, and network issues, and configured and deployed computers and network devices. 
• Managed the company’s Microsoft SharePoint environment.

honors.title: iCIMS Kaizen Champion
honors.issuer: Issued by CEO Colin Day · Sep 2020

honors.title: Verizon CMB & Wireless Certificate of Recognition
honors.issuer: Issued by CIO Shankar Arumugavelu · Jan 2017
